gloss: money on hand; cash one is carrying

definitions.gloss: money on hand; cash one is carrying
definitions.explanation: The money a person has on them at the moment. Common in news reports (a suspect's or victim's cash) and in games, where it is the player's money.

examples.japanese: {所持金|しょじきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{千円|せんえん}→千円：08980_senen⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧だ。
examples.english: All I have on me is a thousand yen.

examples.japanese: {所持金|しょじきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{底|そこ}→底：12560_soko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ついた。
examples.english: I ran out of the money I had with me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{所持金|しょじきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数百円|すうひゃくえん}だった⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: According to the police, the man had only a few hundred yen on him.

notes:
A slightly formal word; in conversation people say ⟦{手持|ても}ち→手持ち：07433_temochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧ or ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦{持|も}っ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧てる⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {所持金|しょじきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{尽|つ}きる→尽きる：12365_tsukiru⟧ / ⟦{底|そこ}→底：12560_soko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つく: to run out of cash
- {所持金|しょじきん}⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧: with no money at all
- {所持金|しょじきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}われる→奪う：01895_ubau⟧: to be robbed of one's cash

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手持|ても}ち→手持ち：07433_temochi⟧: on hand; things or money one has available
- ⟦{所持|しょじ}→所持：12751_shoji⟧: possession, carrying (of anything, such as a passport or a weapon)
